entities.summary: Robert Marcello is a Swedish guitarist who has been a member of the hard rock band Danger Danger since 2003. He has also played for Ironhorse, Obsession, Twenty 4 Seven, and Marcello-Vestry. In late 2009, he was also a stand-in guitarist in the 1980s band House of Lords.
